deviations.claim_in_article: “Oil prices did not fall across the whole market after the plan was withdrawn.”
deviations.issue: This generalizes an observation about Brent futures to oil prices across the whole market; the Ledger verifies only Brent futures’ short-term movement.
deviations.explanation: The scope is broader than HF-009, which concerns Brent futures. The Japanese source already makes this broader claim, so this is a source-level scope deviation.
